name: Data load agent
role: Moves the data into the target database in dependency order, keeping Salesforce record IDs, then recomputes roll-ups and records the Salesforce values used by verification. Also plans the history archive and the work in progress at go-live.
inputs: target database connection (PGHOST, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE)
outputs: Target database: schema app with data
done_when: All rows loaded with 0 rejected, roll-ups recomputed, auto-number counters resynced
reviewer_checks: Row counts per object match the export
Each approval, paused flow and scheduled job is drained or carried over
Retention per history source agreed with compliance

scaling.summary: For large orgs this agent runs as a coordinator with parallel workers, not as a single process.
scaling.coordinator: Builds the load plan from the blueprint's relations: objects grouped into dependency levels, each object split into partitions (by ID range or date), with a watermark for later deltas.
scaling.workers: One worker per partition. Workers at the same dependency level run in parallel; each uses PostgreSQL COPY in batches and reports counts and checksums.
scaling.extraction: Bulk API 2.0 with PK chunking, run in parallel per object within the org's API limits; files staged in cloud storage.
scaling.database: Load mode defers write-time rules; indexes built after the bulk load; very large tables partitioned.
scaling.delta: Change Data Capture or SystemModstamp watermarks keep the target in step until cutover; the final delta runs in a short write freeze.
scaling.reconciliation: Per object and per partition: row counts, ID checksums and sampled field comparisons; derived values checked by the Verification agent.
scaling.files: Attachments (ContentVersion) move on a separate path to blob storage.
